title: От Луки 7 — Luke 7
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Там у одного сотника был болен и лежал при смерти ___.
cases.translation: There, a certain centurion had a servant who was sick and lying at the point of death.
cases.explain: Слуга is the subject of был болен and лежал ('was sick', 'was lying') — the subject takes the nominative.

cases.sentence: Там у одного ___ был болен и лежал при смерти слуга.
cases.translation: There, a certain centurion had a servant who was sick and lying at the point of death.
cases.explain: The preposition у ('at/by', showing possession — 'у сотника' = 'the centurion had') takes the genitive → сотника.

cases.sentence: И, повернувшись к женщине, сказал ___, «Ты видишь эту женщину?»
cases.translation: And turning to the woman, he said to Simon, "Do you see this woman?"
cases.explain: Симон is the indirect object of сказал ('said to Simon') — verbs of speaking take the dative for the person addressed.
Женщина is the direct object of видишь ('you see') — transitive verbs govern the accusative.

cases.translation: The centurion valued this servant of his very much.
cases.explain: The verb дорожить ('to value/cherish') governs the instrumental case → слугой.

cases.sentence: ...и когда он услышал об ___, то послал к нему иудейских старейшин...
cases.translation: ...and when he heard about Jesus, he sent Jewish elders to him...
cases.explain: The preposition об (a form of о, 'about') always takes the prepositional case → Иисусе.

cases.sentence: Иисус как раз в это время исцелил множество людей от ___, недугов...
cases.translation: Jesus at that very time healed many people of diseases, afflictions...
cases.explain: The preposition от ('from/of') takes the genitive → болезней (genitive plural).

cases.sentence: ...потому что он любит наш народ, и это он построил нам ___.
cases.translation: ...for he loves our nation, and it was he who built us a synagogue.
cases.explain: Синагога is the direct object of построил ('built') — accusative case for this feminine -а noun → синагогу.

cases.sentence: «Великий ___ появился среди нас, Бог посетил свой народ».
cases.translation: "A great prophet has appeared among us; God has visited his people!"
cases.explain: Пророк is the subject of появился ('has appeared') — nominative case.

reading.ru: Закончив говорить народу, Иисус отправился в Капернаум.
reading.question: Where did Jesus go after he finished speaking to the people?
reading.explain: After finishing his teaching to the crowd, Jesus went to Capernaum (v.1).

reading.ru: Старейшины пришли к Иисусу и стали горячо просить его.
reading.question: Who came to Jesus to plead earnestly on the centurion's behalf?
reading.explain: The centurion sent Jewish elders, who came to Jesus and pleaded earnestly with him (v.4).

reading.ru: Вскоре после этого Иисус пошел в город, называемый Наин.
reading.question: What was the name of the city Jesus went to soon after healing the centurion's servant?
reading.explain: Soon afterward Jesus went to a town called Nain (v.11).

reading.ru: Когда Господь увидел эту женщину, Он жалился над ней.
reading.question: How did Jesus react when he saw the grieving widow?
reading.explain: Seeing the widow who had lost her only son, the Lord had compassion on her (v.13).

reading.ru: Ты ли тот, кто должен прийти, или нам ожидать кого-то другого?
reading.question: What question did John the Baptist send his disciples to ask Jesus?
options: Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?
Will you free me from prison?
Should we be baptized by you?
reading.correct: Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?
reading.explain: John sent two disciples to ask Jesus, "Are you the one who is to come, or should we look for someone else?" (v.19-20).

reading.ru: Слепые прозревают, хромые ходят, прокаженные очищаются, глухие слышат, мертвые воскресают, и бедным возвещается радостная весть.
reading.question: What evidence did Jesus give John's messengers of who he was?
options: The blind see, the lame walk, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and good news is preached to the poor
He showed them the empty tomb
reading.correct: The blind see, the lame walk, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and good news is preached to the poor
reading.explain: Jesus told John's messengers to report what they had seen: the blind receive sight, the lame walk, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor have good news preached to them (v.22).

reading.question: According to Jesus, where are people who wear fine clothing and live in luxury found?
reading.explain: Jesus said those who wear fine clothing and live in luxury are found in kings' palaces (v.25).

reading.ru: Говорю вам, среди всех рожденных женщинами нет более великого, чем Иоанн, но наименьший в Божьем Царстве больше его.
reading.question: How does Jesus describe John the Baptist compared to the least in God's kingdom?
options: No one born of women is greater than John, yet the least in God's kingdom is greater than he
John is the greatest person in God's kingdom
John is equal to the least in God's kingdom
John is greater than everyone, including those in God's kingdom
reading.correct: No one born of women is greater than John, yet the least in God's kingdom is greater than he
reading.explain: Jesus says among those born of women none is greater than John, but the least in God's kingdom is greater than he (v.28).

reading.ru: Но мудрость оправдана всеми детьми ее.
reading.question: How does Jesus conclude his remarks about this unresponsive generation?
options: Wisdom is justified by all her children
This generation will be judged harshly
No one will believe the prophets
reading.correct: Wisdom is justified by all her children
reading.explain: Jesus ends the comparison by saying wisdom is justified (proved right) by all her children (v.35).

reading.ru: Один из фарисеев пригласил Иисуса к себе на обед.
reading.question: Who invited Jesus to a meal at the start of the anointing story?
reading.explain: One of the Pharisees invited Jesus to eat with him (v.36).

reading.ru: Женщина встала сзади у ног Иисуса и плача обливала его ноги слезами.
reading.question: What did the sinful woman do at Jesus' feet?
options: She stood behind him weeping and wet his feet with her tears
She anointed his head with oil
She sat beside him and prayed silently
reading.correct: She stood behind him weeping and wet his feet with her tears
reading.explain: Standing behind him at his feet, weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears (v.38).

reading.ru: Два человека были должны одному и тому же взаимодавцу, — начал Иисус.
reading.question: What parable does Jesus tell to Simon the Pharisee?
options: Two men owed money to the same money-lender
A shepherd lost one of his sheep
A farmer sowed seed on different soils
A king forgave a servant's debt of ten thousand talents
reading.correct: Two men owed money to the same money-lender
reading.explain: Jesus begins the parable: "Two people were in debt to a certain lender..." (v.41).

reading.ru: Иисус же сказал женщине, твоя вера спасла тебя, иди с миром.
reading.question: What are Jesus' final words to the woman in this chapter?
options: Your faith has saved you; go in peace
Your sins are forgiven; sin no more
Follow me and be my disciple
Return to your family in Nain
reading.correct: Your faith has saved you; go in peace
reading.explain: Jesus tells the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace" (v.50).
